ticket.title: Rootly CLI - Incident Not Found
ticket.description:
**Org ID:** [5822](<https://admin.rootly.com/teams/frayt>)

**Customer: FRAYT**

**What is the issue?**

Customer reported an issue fetching an incident using the command: `rootly incidents get INC-31`

Their example output is shared in a github issue: [https://github.com/rootlyhq/rootly-cli/issues/28](<https://github.com/rootlyhq/rootly-cli/issues/28>)

```
λ rootly incidents list INC-31
╭────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────┬──────────┬───────────────────────────┬──────────╮
│ ID     │ Title                                                        │ Status    │ Severity │ Started                   │ Duration │
├────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────┼──────────┼───────────────────────────┼──────────┤
│ INC-31 │ [redacted]                                                   │ resolved  │ SEV3     │ May 18, 2026 02:06 PM EDT │ 52m      │
╰────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────┴──────────┴───────────────────────────┴──────────╯

λ rootly incidents get INC-31
Error: failed to get incident: incident not found: INC-31
```

Per Claude, `rootly incidents get` is looking for a UUID to use with `/v1/incidents/{id}` even though the help text states that `INC-123` format is accepted.

---

**Who does this affect?**

CLI users

---

**Steps to Reproduce**

1. Run `rootly incident get INC-<sequential_id>` 

---

**Customer Slack Thread**

[https://rootly-workspace.slack.com/archives/C0AGU8VKMC0/p1779221196736479](<https://rootly-workspace.slack.com/archives/C0AGU8VKMC0/p1779221196736479>)

**Reason for Priority (Please fill out for urgent)** 

Medium - CLI tool not widely used

comments.body: Bumping to high because customer is fishing for updates. @quentin who own the CLI tool, is IR the right bucket for this? Should be an easy fix I think

comments.author: Devin
comments.body:
### 1) Restated problem
`rootly incidents get INC-31` should return incident #31, but returned `incident not found: INC-31` even though `rootly incidents list` shows INC-31 and the help text advertises the `INC-123` format.

### 2) Scope
Unclear / adjacent. The fault and fix live in the Rootly CLI (rootlyhq/rootly-cli), not the monolith. The monolith Incidents API behaves as designed. Matt's open question about who owns the CLI still stands.

### 3) Classification
bug, low severity (now). The CLI sent the display ID as is. It looks **already fixed upstream**, so no monolith change is needed.

### 4) Evidence
**Facts**
- rootly-cli issue #28 (same repro) was closed 2026-06-04 by PR #32, "Fix incidents get/update/delete with sequential IDs (INC-xxx)": https://github.com/rootlyhq/rootly-cli/pull/32
- The fix shipped in CLI **v0.3.2** (2026-06-04). The latest release is v0.6.1.
- In the GH issue, another user reported that omitting the `INC-` prefix worked, and that the API returned `{"title":"Not found or unauthorized","status":"404"}`.
- On current rootly-cli master, `TestNormalizeIncidentID`, `TestRunGetNormalizesSequentialID` and `TestRunGetAcceptsUUID` pass locally.
- The linked Pylon #26340 is still `waiting_on_you`. Its last Rootly update was 2026-05-22.

**Findings**
- config/initializers/cancan.rb:55-67: for Incident, the API splits the id on `-`. A numeric first part means a `sequential_id` lookup. Anything else (`INC-31` gives `INC`) falls through to a FriendlyId slug lookup, which misses.
- app/controllers/api/v1/application_controller.rb:51: the miss renders the 404 "Not found or unauthorized".
- rootly-cli internal/api/client.go:1151-1161: `NormalizeIncidentID` strips `INC-` (case-insensitive).
- rootly-cli internal/cmd/incidents/get.go:41: `get` (also update, delete, workflows run, status-page events) now normalizes before calling `/v1/incidents/{id}`.

### 5) Root-cause hypothesis
The customer was very likely on a CLI version older than v0.3.2. Those ver
